what: OpenRouter for tools: founders do not want to sign up for 1000 SaaS APIs. Request for an open protocol where any merchant hosts a tool, agents discover it, and pay ~$0.05 per request.
why_us: Явный agent-economy gap. Высокий engagement + повтор в треде. Инфра для микро-монетизации tools/MCP.
engagement: 850 likes, 126 replies, 371 bookmarks on original; 101 likes on 'someone should build'

what: One credit card / wallet app that can cancel ANY subscription from a single interface instead of hunting cancel flows on vendor sites.
why_us: Классическая consumer+SMB боль subscription hell. WTP ('I would pay a great deal') от платёжеспособного инвестора.
revenue: $5-15/mo consumer or card interchange + cancellation fee

what: X identity: people cannot tell real vs fake accounts after anyone can buy a checkmark. Request for true verification of who/what is real.
why_us: Повторяемая trust-боль соцсетей. Возможность для third-party identity / proof-of-personhood слоя.

what: G2 review of Aha!: overpriced roadmap tool, UI basic, CS lacks empathy; reviewer says product roadmap is commoditized and AI can replace the suite.
why_us: Платёжеспособные product teams ищут дешёвую AI-замену Aha/Productboard. Классический 'too expensive + wish AI did it'.
engagement: verified G2 review Sep 11 2026 titled Overpriced / AI can replace

what: QuickBooks Online: predatory 40% price hike after lock-in; migration cost higher than increase. Users trapped by data gravity.
why_us: Системная боль accounting SaaS. Спрос на portable books + cheaper QBO alternative with easy import.
revenue: SMB already paying QBO Plus; 40% hike = switching window
engagement: G2 review Jul 28 2026 Intuit/Quickbooks Predatory Pricing model

what: Ask HN: looking for a non-cloud Wispr Flow alternative that runs on-device. Repeated pattern of people building local Whisper wrappers because $15/mo cloud dictation is too expensive and not private.
why_us: Повторяемый demand gap local STT. Несколько Show HN (FnScribe, Mellon, Handy, Glimpse, VoiceInk).
engagement: fresh Ask HN + multiple prior Show HN threads on same pain

what: Yaak (MIT-licensed offline API client) crossed $5k MRR. Founder was unsure open-source + offline would monetize.
why_us: Доказанный OSS-to-paid паттерн для devtools. Конкретная цифра и свежий пост.

what: BeatAPI: image/video model API layer born from founder pain wiring models into BeatDesign. 744 signups in 25 days, ~$900 revenue, 284 billed usage records, 33 top-ups.
why_us: Свежий AI infra wrapper с воронкой curiosity→first call→top-up. Честные conversion numbers.

what: TooEasy habit tracker: solo founder in Vietnam, $1.8k MRR while keeping a 9-5. Target $10k/mo.
why_us: Микро-SaaS habit category still prints. Конкретный MRR и solo constraint.

what: Indie SaaS for combat-sport clubs crossed €1.2k MRR while founder still delivers food and coaches. Clubs pay; product growing but not yet family-living income.
why_us: Вертикальный niche SaaS (JJB/gyms) с доказанной willingness to pay клубов.

what: Flidget.com: cancel-flow conversation tool for SaaS. $4k MRR mostly via word of mouth after talking to users at the exact cancel moment.
why_us: Мета-боль churn + продукт на этой боли. Паттерн 'ask at worst moment'.

what: Tool that connects to a codebase and captures screenshots of every screen / edge-case into one live product canvas.
why_us: QA + design-system + onboarding pain. Узкий B2B для product/eng teams.
